title: Advanced Phrasal Verbs
completion_message: ¡Brillante! El uso de Phrasal Verbs avanzados te hace sonar como un hablante nativo experimentado en el entorno corporativo.

stages.title: Phrasal Verbs de Negocios Nivel B2 (Parte 1)

parts.visual:
Resolución de Problemas: 
- Iron out (Planchar / Resolver pequeños problemas o detalles). 
Ej: We need to iron out a few details before signing. 
- Look into (Investigar / Averiguar). 
Ej: I don't know why the server crashed, but I will look into it.
parts.audio: Problem Solving. 'Iron out' means to resolve small problems or details. For example: We need to iron out a few details before signing. 'Look into' means to investigate. For example: I don't know why the server crashed, but I will look into it.

parts.visual:
Comunicación y Éxito: 
- Bring up (Mencionar un tema / Sacar a relucir). 
Ej: Don't bring up the budget during the meeting. 
- Pull off (Lograr algo muy difícil). 
Ej: We had only two days, but we pulled it off! (¡Lo logramos!).
parts.audio: Communication and Success. 'Bring up' means to mention a topic. For example: Don't bring up the budget during the meeting. 'Pull off' means to achieve something very difficult. For example: We had only two days, but we pulled it off!

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el Phrasal Verb correcto para la situación.

questions.question: The contract is mostly fine. We just need to ____ a few details. (Resolver/Planchar).
questions.explanation: Iron out = planchar, alisar, resolver detalles menores.

questions.question: I'm not sure why the payment failed, but I will ____ it immediately. (Investigar).
questions.explanation: Look into = investigar, revisar un asunto.

questions.question: During the meeting, please don't ____ the salary cuts. (Mencionar el tema).
questions.explanation: Bring up = sacar un tema a colación, mencionarlo.

questions.question: Winning that contract was almost impossible, but our team ____ it ____! (Lo logró).
questions.explanation: Pull off = lograr o conseguir algo que parecía muy difícil.

questions.question: We need to ____ the meeting until next Friday because the CEO is sick. (Posponer).
questions.explanation: Put off = posponer. (Call off es cancelar).

questions.question: The deal was completely cancelled. They had to ____ it ____. (Cancelar).
Sales have started to ____ after the new marketing campaign. (Repuntar / Mejorar).
questions.explanation: Pick up = mejorar, incrementar, repuntar (ventas, economía).

questions.question: Can you ____ a quick summary of the report? (Redactar / Preparar un documento).
questions.explanation: Draw up = redactar (un contrato, una lista, un resumen).

questions.question: We had to ____ some staff because of the financial crisis. (Despedir por recortes).
questions.explanation: Lay off = despedir personal (normalmente por razones económicas, no por mal desempeño).

questions.question: Before we decide, let's ____ the numbers one more time. (Revisar detalladamente).
questions.explanation: Go over = revisar, examinar paso a paso.

questions.question: I don't think we can ____ doing this project without a bigger budget. (Lograr salir impune / Hacerlo de todos modos).
questions.explanation: Get away with = salir impune, salirse con la suya, hacer algo sin consecuencias negativas.

questions.question: The negotiations ____ because they couldn't agree on the price. (Fracasaron / Se vinieron abajo).
questions.explanation: Fall through = fracasar, venirse abajo (un plan o trato).

questions.question: We need someone to ____ for Sarah while she is on maternity leave. (Sustituir / Reemplazar temporalmente).
questions.explanation: Fill in = sustituir a alguien temporalmente.

questions.question: Please ____ this application form. (Completar / Rellenar un formulario).
questions.explanation: Fill out = completar o rellenar un formulario. (En UK a veces usan fill in para lo mismo).

questions.question: If you don't know the word, ____ it ____ in the dictionary. (Buscar información).
questions.explanation: Look up = buscar información (en un libro, diccionario o internet).

questions.question: They decided to ____ the rival company. (Adquirir / Tomar el control).
questions.explanation: Take over = adquirir, tomar el control de una empresa o proyecto.

questions.question: Our new product has really ____ in the Asian market. (Tenido éxito repentino / Despegado).
questions.explanation: Take off = despegar, tener éxito rápido.

questions.question: I can't hear you well, you're ____. (Entrecortándose en el teléfono/video).
questions.explanation: Break up = entrecortarse la comunicación (en llamadas o videollamadas).

questions.question: Don't ____ to me like that! I'm your manager. (Hablar con falta de respeto).
questions.explanation: Talk down to someone = hablar con tono de superioridad o condescendencia.

questions.question: He always tries to ____ ____ the fact that he went to Harvard. (Presumir / Exhibir).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la preposición correcta para el Phrasal Verb.

questions.question: We need to iron ____ the details. (Resolver/Planchar)
I will look ____ the problem. (Investigar)
Don't bring ____ the budget. (Mencionar)
We managed to pull it ____! (Lograr algo difícil)
They had to put ____ the meeting until next week. (Posponer)
The deal fell ____. (Fracasó/Se cayó)
Let's draw ____ a contract. (Redactar)
They laid ____ 50 employees. (Despidieron)
We will take ____ the company next year. (Adquirir)
Sales are starting to pick ____. (Repuntar)
